styleFormula: Polished stylized low-poly dark-fantasy woodland with hand-shaped faceted forms, softened bevels, asymmetrical silhouettes, and visible craft details. Environment uses rain-dark umber timber, deep moss greens, slate blue-gray stone, muted meadow gold, and charcoal indigo shadow; safe objectives use restrained lantern amber and memory cues use foxfire cyan. Materials stay matte, rough, and tactile under warm practical light and cool atmospheric moonlight. Maintain strong gameplay-scale silhouettes, sparse surface noise, readable negative space, and consistent three-quarter 3D proportions.
